note.en: One of the oldest morning ragas. Its deep, prayerful notes feel like the first light touching the fields.
note.hinglish: Subah ke sabse puraane raagon mein se ek. Iske gehre, prarthana jaise sur kheton par pehli roshni jaise lagte hain.

note.en: Soft and gentle, like a mother waking her child. A lovely way to begin the day together.
note.hinglish: Narm aur pyaara, jaise maa apne bachche ko jagaati hai. Din ki shuruaat ke liye bahut sundar.

note.en: A warm afternoon raga with a sweet ache of waiting. Perfect with a rest after lunch.
note.hinglish: Dopahar ka garm raag, jismein intezaar ki meethi kasak hai. Khaane ke baad aaraam ke saath badhiya.

note.en: Often the first raga music students learn. Its gentle evening glow feels like lighting a diya.
note.hinglish: Aksar sangeet seekhne wale isse shuru karte hain. Iski shaam ki roshni diya jalaane jaisi lagti hai.

note.en: A tender night raga full of love. Lovely to listen to while lying on your left side before sleep.
note.hinglish: Pyaar se bhara raat ka komal raag. Sone se pehle baayein karvat let kar sunne ke liye sundar.

note.en: Slow and grand, like the quiet night sky. It helps a busy mind settle.
note.hinglish: Dheema aur bhavya, jaise shaant raat ka aasmaan. Bechain mann ko thehrata hai.
